label: CCR gateway (GLM + GPT merged into one /model list)
note: claude-code-router v3 aggregates every configured provider behind one gateway, and CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY makes Claude Code list them all under /model as provider/model. CCR v3 stores its config in ~/.claude-code-router/config.sqlite, so providers, the client key, and the agent profile MUST be created once by hand in the web UI (ccr ui, http://127.0.0.1:3458) — an installer cannot write them. Paste the generated client key into ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN below.

service.label: claude-code-router
service.loginHint: ccr ui    # admin UI on :3458 — add providers, create a client API key, then set that key here
